title: unsafe impl Send is the correct choice given ceph crate's missing impl
description: The ceph crate marks Rados as Sync but not Send — an apparent oversight since librados is documented as thread-safe. We store _rados: Rados only to prevent premature rados_shutdown, not for concurrent access. All concurrent I/O goes through Arc<IoCtx> which IS Send+Sync. The safety comment is accurate. A future contributor might suggest removing the unsafe impl — resist unless the ceph crate adds the missing Send impl. Do not try to work around it with Mutex<Rados> (Mutex<T>: Send requires T: Send) or by mem::forget(rados) (breaks Drop lifetime safety).
